name: am_sparse
sql: SELECT public.box_am_micro('s2.boxes_gist',ARRAY(SELECT q FROM s2.probes WHERE id<=32 ORDER BY id),64)
answer_sql: SELECT (64) * sum((SELECT count(*) FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && q)) FROM unnest(ARRAY(SELECT q FROM s2.probes WHERE id<=32 ORDER BY id))q

name: am_medium
sql: SELECT public.box_am_micro('s2.boxes_gist',ARRAY(SELECT box(center(q),center(q)+point(20,20)) FROM s2.probes WHERE id<=32 ORDER BY id),16)
answer_sql: SELECT (16) * sum((SELECT count(*) FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && q)) FROM unnest(ARRAY(SELECT box(center(q),center(q)+point(20,20)) FROM s2.probes WHERE id<=32 ORDER BY id))q

name: am_absent
sql: SELECT public.box_am_micro('s2.boxes_gist',ARRAY(SELECT box(point(2000+id,2000),point(2000+id,2000)) FROM s2.probes WHERE id<=32 ORDER BY id),64)
answer_sql: SELECT (64) * sum((SELECT count(*) FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && q)) FROM unnest(ARRAY(SELECT box(point(2000+id,2000),point(2000+id,2000)) FROM s2.probes WHERE id<=32 ORDER BY id))q

name: am_allmatch
answer_sql: SELECT (8) * sum((SELECT count(*) FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && q)) FROM unnest(ARRAY[box(point(-1,-1),point(2000,2000))])q
